statement: The CLI service pipeline's build stage finalizes the generated binding records it deploys: after stampArtifactDescriptor writes the real artifact descriptor into manifest.json, runBuild restamps every generated binding target's manifest_digest in bindings.json to the canonical sha256 digest of the stamped normalized manifest via the deployment-record generator's single digest-and-serialization owner (restampDeploymentBindings), so the public generate->build->deploy path produces CREATE BINDING statements whose pinned digest equals the ServiceInstallCatalogOwner's stored manifestDigest for a genuinely built wasm component. Verified at HEAD df0461143: runGenerate always digests the placeholderArtifact() manifest, runBuild stamped only manifest.json, runDeploy substitutes only package_id, so CREATE BINDING deterministically failed PACKAGE_STATE_CORRUPT on the CLI path (live witness public-path-multinode-baseline-20260811T090119Z; restamp-digest equality with the stored catalog row proven empirically). Deterministic guard: generator unit test proves digest + byte-canonical rewrite; the real-componentize pipeline test proves the built tree pins the stamped digest, red-on-revert. The binding contract's digest pinning (minimal-deployment-binding-v0-declaration) is not weakened. Supersedes service-pipeline-binding-digest-build-restamp (unlandable: evidence-less first commit-step recorded a new-quest-only integrity violation).
